vibe_rationale: Decade-long curated mural festival that built Long Beach's public art scene; art-only and mostly outdoor, with strong credibility.
fit_notes: Public art audience with no age or wellness profile recorded, so adjacency to health is weak. Twenty-eight listed partners and public backers, a partnership page and a named partnership director. A brand role would be a wall commission or community event rather than a booth. US-based, so activation needs a local partner.
